0279.name: decline push-up
0279.description: A push-up with the feet raised on a surface. The incline puts more load on the upper chest and shoulders.
instructions: Place your hands on the ground slightly wider than shoulder-width apart, with your feet elevated on a stable surface.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to toe, engaging your core muscles.
Lower your chest towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your body.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

1311.name: wide hand push up
1311.description: A push-up with your hands placed wider than your shoulders. It puts more emphasis on the chest and less on the triceps.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to toe.
Lower your chest towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

0662.name: push-up
0662.description: The classic push-up from a high plank. Works the chest, shoulders, triceps and core in one move.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Engage your core and lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your body in a straight line.
Pause for a moment when your chest is just above the ground, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

0259.name: close-grip push-up
0259.description: A push-up with the hands placed close together under the chest. It shifts more of the load onto the triceps.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands placed close together, directly under your shoulders.
Engage your core and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

3211.name: kneeling push-up (male)
3211.description: A beginner-friendly push-up with the knees on the floor. It builds chest, shoulder and triceps strength with less load than a standard push-up.
instructions: Start by kneeling on the ground with your hands shoulder-width apart, fingers pointing forward.
Extend your legs behind you, resting on the balls of your feet, so that your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Engage your core and lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Continue lowering until your chest is just above the ground, then push back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

0308.name: dumbbell fly
0308.description: The classic flat bench dumbbell fly. The arms open in an arc to stretch and squeeze the chest.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Extend your arms straight up over your chest, with a slight bend in your elbows.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, lower your arms out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Pause for a moment, then reverse the movement and bring the dumbbells back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

0405.name: dumbbell seated shoulder press
0405.description: Seated with back support, you press dumbbells from shoulder height to overhead. It builds the shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, resting on your thighs.
Raise the dumbbells to shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

0334.name: dumbbell lateral raise
0334.description: The standard standing dumbbell lateral raise. Lifting the arms out to the sides builds the side delts.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Keep your back straight and engage your core.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the floor, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

0310.name: dumbbell front raise
0310.description: A standing dumbbell front raise. You lift the weights to shoulder height to train the front delts.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your thighs.
Keeping your arms straight, exhale and lift the dumbbells in front of you until they are at shoulder level.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

0652.name: pull-up
0652.description: You hang from a bar with an overhand grip and pull your chin above it. A classic builder for the lats and upper back.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your arms fully extended.
Engage your core and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pull your body up towards the bar by bending your elbows and bringing your chest towards the bar.
Pause at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

1330.name: dumbbell reverse grip incline bench one arm row
1330.description: A one-arm row with an underhand grip, supported on an incline bench. It works the upper back and biceps one side at a time.
instructions: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Place a dumbbell on the floor next to the bench.
Stand facing the bench with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend at the waist and place your left knee and left hand on the bench for support.
Pick up the dumbbell with your right hand using a reverse grip (palm facing down).
Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the dumbbell up towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Squeeze your back muscles at the top of the movement.
Lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position in a controlled manner.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Switch sides and repeat the exercise with your left arm.

0293.name: dumbbell bent over row
0293.description: A two-arm dumbbell row done bent over. You pull the weights to the chest to build the upper back.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your body.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Let your arms hang straight down towards the floor, with your elbows slightly bent.
Pull the dumbbells up towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

0988.name: band one arm standing low row
0988.description: A standing one-arm low row with a band. It trains the back and biceps.
instructions: Attach the band to a stable anchor point at waist height.
Stand facing the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the band with one hand, palm facing inward, and step back to create tension in the band.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Pull the band towards your waist, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly release the band back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

0983.name: band kneeling one arm pulldown
0983.description: A kneeling one-arm pulldown with a band, driving the elbow toward the ribs. It trains the lats.
instructions: Attach the band to a sturdy anchor point above your head.
Kneel down and hold the band with one hand, palm facing down.
Extend your arm fully overhead, keeping your elbow slightly bent.
Engage your lat muscles and pull the band down towards your side, bringing your elbow towards your ribcage.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

1022.name: band standing rear delt row
1022.description: A standing rear delt row with a band, pulling the handles toward the chest. It trains the rear delts.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place the band under your feet.
Hold the band handles with your palms facing each other and your arms extended in front of you.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Pull the band towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

0383.name: dumbbell reverse fly
0383.description: Bent forward, you open your arms wide with dumbbells. It targets the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Extend your arms straight down in front of you, palms facing each other.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

1677.name: dumbbell seated bicep curl
1677.description: A dumbbell biceps curl performed seated. It keeps your legs out of the movement.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing up.
Keep your back straight and your elbows close to your torso.
Exhale and curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders, contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

0313.name: dumbbell hammer curl
0313.description: The standard hammer curl with the palms facing in. It trains the brachialis, biceps and forearms.
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your torso.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and rotate the palms of your hands until they are facing forward.
This will be your starting position.
Now, keeping the upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Then, inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

0430.name: dumbbell standing triceps extension
0430.description: Standing, you lower a dumbbell behind your head and press it back up. It builds the back of the upper arm.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Raise the dumbbell overhead, keeping your arm straight.
Bend your elbow and lower the dumbbell behind your head, keeping your upper arm stationary.
Extend your arm back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

1760.name: dumbbell goblet squat
1760.description: A squat holding one dumbbell at your chest. Trains the quads and glutes while keeping your torso upright.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands.
Keeping your chest up and core engaged, lower your body down into a squat position by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

1459.name: dumbbell romanian deadlift
1459.description: A hip hinge with dumbbells that lowers them down the legs while your back stays flat. It trains the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, hinge at the hips and lower the dumbbells towards the ground, allowing your knees to bend slightly.
Lower the dumbbells until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then push through your heels and engage your glutes to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

0620.name: lying leg raise flat bench
0620.description: Lying on a flat bench, you raise and lower straight legs. Works the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie flat on a flat bench with your back pressed against it.
Place your hands under your glutes for support.
Keep your legs straight and together, and lift them up towards the ceiling.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

0872.name: reverse crunch
0872.description: A crunch that curls the hips off the floor with the knees bent. It targets the lower abs.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended along your sides.
Bend your knees and lift your feet off the ground, bringing your thighs perpendicular to the floor.
Contract your abs and curl your hips off the floor, bringing your knees towards your chest.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

2135.name: weighted front plank
2135.description: A forearm plank held with extra weight on your back. Builds core strength and stability.
instructions: Start by lying face down on the floor.
Place your forearms on the ground, with your elbows directly under your shoulders.
Extend your legs straight out behind you, with your toes on the ground.
Engage your core and lift your body off the ground, balancing on your forearms and toes.
Keep your body in a straight line from your head to your heels.
Hold this position for the desired amount of time.
Lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

0705.name: side bridge v. 2
0705.description: Lying on your side, you hold your hips up off the floor on your forearm. Works the obliques and core.
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Place your forearm on the ground directly below your shoulder, with your elbow bent at a 90-degree angle.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the ground, creating a straight line from your head to your feet.
Hold this position for the desired amount of time.
Lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.

0276.name: dead bug
0276.description: A core drill where you extend opposite arm and leg while keeping the lower back pressed to the floor. It builds stability in the abs.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended towards the ceiling.
Bend your knees and lift your legs off the ground, creating a 90-degree angle at your hips and knees.
Engage your core and lower back to press your lower back into the ground.
Slowly lower your right arm and left leg towards the ground, keeping them straight and hovering just above the floor.
Pause for a moment, then return to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with your left arm and right leg.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

0274.name: crunch floor
0274.description: A basic floor crunch. You curl the shoulders off the ground to work the upper abs.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engage your abs and lift your shoulders off the ground, curling forward towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

0687.name: russian twist
0687.description: Seated and leaning back, you rotate your torso from side to side. Works the obliques and abs.
instructions: Sit on the ground with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Lean back slightly while keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Hold your hands together in front of your chest or hold a weight if desired.
Lift your feet off the ground, balancing on your sit bones.
Twist your torso to the right, bringing your hands or weight towards the right side of your body.
Pause for a moment, then twist your torso to the left, bringing your hands or weight towards the left side of your body.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

0025.name: barbell bench press
0025.description: The classic flat bench press. Lower the bar to your chest and press it up to build the chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed against the bench.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the barbell off the rack and hold it directly above your chest with your arms fully extended.
Lower the barbell slowly towards your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in.
Pause for a moment when the barbell touches your chest.
Push the barbell back up to the starting position by extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

0289.name: dumbbell bench press
0289.description: The classic dumbbell press on a flat bench. It builds the chest, shoulders and triceps with a good range of motion.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed against the bench.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, with your palms facing forward and your arms extended above your chest.
Lower the dumbbells slowly to the sides of your chest, keeping your elbows at a 90-degree angle.
Pause for a moment, then push the dumbbells back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

0314.name: dumbbell incline bench press
0314.description: An incline dumbbell bench press. The raised bench shifts the work toward the upper chest.
instructions: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Sit on the bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed firmly against the bench.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward, and lift them to shoulder height.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to the sides of your chest, keeping your elbows at a 90-degree angle.
Push the dumbbells back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

0375.name: dumbbell pullover
0375.description: Lying across or along a bench, you lower one dumbbell behind your head and pull it back over your chest. It works the chest and lats with a deep stretch.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your head at one end and your feet on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands and extend your arms straight above your chest.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, slowly lower the dumbbell behind your head until you feel a stretch in your chest and shoulders.
Pause for a moment, then raise the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

0493.name: incline push-up
0493.description: You perform a push-up with hands elevated. It makes the push-up easier and trains the chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Place your hands on an elevated surface, such as a bench or step, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Extend your legs behind you, resting on the balls of your feet, creating a straight line from your head to your heels.
Lower your chest towards the elevated surface by bending your elbows, keeping your body in a straight line.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

3294.name: archer push up
3294.description: A wide push-up that shifts the weight to one arm while the other arm stays straight. It trains the chest and triceps on the way to one arm push-ups.
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Extend one arm straight out to the side, parallel to the ground.
Lower your body by bending your elbows, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Push back up to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, extending the opposite arm out to the side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

4075.name: band chest fly
4075.description: Standing band fly bringing the hands together in front of the chest. It trains the pecs.
instructions: Anchor the band behind you at chest height and hold the ends.
Stand in a staggered stance.
Start with arms out to the sides and slightly bent.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest.
Return slowly under control.

1430.name: chest dip (on dip-pull-up cage)
1430.description: A chest dip done on a dip station with a forward lean. It works the lower chest, triceps and front shoulders.
instructions: Adjust the dip bars to a height that allows you to comfortably grip them.
Stand between the bars and place your hands on each bar, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Jump up and straighten your arms, supporting your body weight on the bars.
Bend your knees and cross your ankles behind you.
Lower your body by bending your elbows, keeping your chest up and your shoulders down.
Continue lowering until your shoulders are below your elbows or until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Push through your palms and extend your elbows to raise your body back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

1162.name: barbell standing military press
1162.description: A strict standing overhead press with a barbell. It builds shoulder and triceps strength.
instructions: Unrack the bar at shoulder height, hands just outside your shoulders.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar straight up, moving your head slightly back then through.
Lock out overhead with the bar over your mid-foot.
Lower the bar back to your collarbone with control.

0426.name: dumbbell standing overhead press
0426.description: Standing, you press dumbbells from your shoulders to overhead. It builds the shoulders, triceps and trunk stability.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to shoulder level.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

0404.name: dumbbell seated shoulder press (parallel grip)
0404.description: Seated, you press dumbbells overhead with palms facing each other. A shoulder-friendly press for the shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing inward.
Raise the dumbbells to shoulder height, elbows bent and palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

0396.name: dumbbell seated lateral raise
0396.description: Seated, you raise dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height. It builds the side shoulders without leg drive.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and a dumbbell in each hand, resting on your thighs.
Keep your back straight and core engaged.
Raise the dumbbells to your sides with a slight bend in your elbows, until your arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

0921.name: band standing external shoulder rotation
0921.description: An external rotation with a band. It strengthens the rotator cuff.
instructions: Anchor the band at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the end with your elbow bent at 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm outward away from your body.
Return slowly.
Finish reps, then switch arms.

0924.name: band standing internal shoulder rotation
0924.description: An internal rotation with a band. It strengthens the rotator cuff.
instructions: Anchor the band at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the end with your elbow bent at 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm across toward your belly.
Return slowly.
Finish reps, then switch arms.

1017.name: band y-raise
1017.description: A Y-raise with a band, lifting the arms into a Y shape. It trains the delts and upper back.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the band in front of your thighs with your palms facing inwards.
Keep your arms straight and lift them up and out to the sides, forming a 'Y' shape with your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

0032.name: barbell deadlift
0032.description: Lift the bar from the floor by driving the hips and legs until you stand tall. Trains the glutes, hamstrings and back.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and the barbell on the ground in front of you.
Bend your knees and hinge at the hips to lower your torso and grip the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and chest lifted as you drive through your heels to lift the barbell off the ground, extending your hips and knees.
As you stand up straight, squeeze your glutes and keep your core engaged.
Lower the barbell back down to the ground by bending at the hips and knees, keeping your back straight.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

3593.name: barbell squat
3593.description: The classic barbell squat that builds strength in the thighs and hips.
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your feet to stand tall.

1060.name: barbell hip thrust
1060.description: A bench-supported bridge with a barbell across your hips. It is a go-to move for building strong glutes.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a padded barbell over your hips.
Plant your feet hip-width apart and drive through your heels.
Lift your hips until your torso is level with the floor.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and keep your chin tucked.
Lower your hips under control.
Repeat without arching your lower back.

1581.name: bodyweight rear lunge
1581.description: A lunge where you step back instead of forward. It is gentler on the knees and focuses on the glutes.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees are bent at about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and your front heel planted.
Push through your front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs or finish all reps on one side first.

3928.name: bodyweight single leg deadlift
3928.description: Hinge forward on one leg while the other reaches back. It builds hamstring and glute strength and trains balance.
instructions: Stand on one foot with a soft knee and your arms hanging in front.
Hinge at the hips and extend the free leg straight behind you.
Lower your torso until it is nearly parallel to the floor, back flat.
Squeeze your glute to stand tall again.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

4031.name: band hip abduction
4031.description: Standing leg raise to the side against a band. It targets the outer hip and glute muscles.
instructions: Anchor the band low and loop it around the ankle farthest from the anchor.
Stand tall and hold a support for balance.
Lift the working leg out to the side without leaning.
Pause, then lower slowly against the band.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

4029.name: band hip adduction
4029.description: Standing leg movement against a band that squeezes the thigh inward. It strengthens the inner thigh.
instructions: Anchor the band low and loop it around the ankle nearest the anchor.
Stand tall and hold a support for balance.
Pull the working leg across in front of the other leg.
Pause for a moment and return slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

0911.name: band lying leg curl
0911.description: A leg curl while lying down using a band. It targets the hamstrings.
instructions: Lie face down with a band anchored to your ankles.
Keep your hips pressed down.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Squeeze your hamstrings.
Lower slowly.

1004.name: band squat
1004.description: A squat with a band above the knees. It trains the glutes and thighs.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, with the band placed just above your knees.
Keeping your chest up and core engaged, push your hips back and bend your knees to lower into a squat position.
Make sure your knees are tracking over your toes and your weight is in your heels.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

6607.name: band lateral walk
6607.description: Side stepping with a loop band around the legs. It fires up the hip abductors and glutes.
instructions: Put a loop band around your legs just above the knees or ankles.
Stand in a quarter squat with feet hip-width apart.
Step sideways with the lead foot, keeping tension on the band.
Bring the trailing foot in without letting the feet touch.
Walk several steps one way, then return the other way.

1513.name: band good morning
1513.description: A hip hinge with a band across your shoulders. It strengthens the hamstrings, glutes and lower back.
instructions: Stand on the band and loop it behind your neck across your shoulders.
Keep your knees softly bent and your back flat.
Push your hips back and lean your torso forward.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall again.

0909.name: band lunges
0909.description: Lunges with band resistance. They build the quads and glutes with extra tension.
instructions: Stand on the band with the ends held at your shoulders.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through the front heel to return.
Alternate legs.

4442.name: assisted bulgarian split squat
4442.description: A single-leg squat with the rear foot raised on a bench and a hand lightly holding a support for balance. Trains quads and glutes with less wobble.
instructions: Stand facing away from a bench and hold a sturdy post or rack with one hand for balance.
Place the top of your rear foot on a bench behind you.
Step your front foot far enough forward to stay balanced.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee tracking over your toes.
Drive through the front heel to stand, then switch legs after your set.

6560.name: 90 to 90 stretch
6560.description: A seated hip stretch with both legs bent at right angles. It loosens the hip rotators and the glutes.
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg bent in front and the other bent out to the side, both at about 90 degrees.
Sit tall with your hands on the floor.
Hinge forward over the front shin until you feel a stretch in the hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Come back up slowly.
Switch sides.

1379.name: dumbbell seated calf raise
1379.description: Seated calf raise with a dumbbell resting on your knees. The bent knee focuses on the soleus beneath the calf.
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground and a dumbbell resting on your thighs.
Place the balls of your feet on a raised surface such as a step or block, with your heels hanging off the edge.
Hold onto the dumbbell for stability.
Raise your heels as high as possible, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

1178.name: dumbbell standing single leg calf raise
1178.description: A one-leg calf raise holding a dumbbell for a challenging calf workout.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and stand on one foot on a step.
Hold a wall or rail with your other hand for balance.
Lower your heel to a full stretch.
Press up onto your toes as high as possible.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

1246.name: hollow hold
1246.description: A gymnastics-style hold with your shoulders and legs lifted. It builds deep core strength.
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms overhead and legs straight.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lift your shoulders and legs a few inches off the ground.
Hold the shape and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then rest.

5649.name: hollow rock
5649.description: Rocking on your back in a hollow body position to challenge your core.
instructions: Lie on your back and lift your arms and legs into a hollow position.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Rock back and forth like a boat.
Keep your body rigid.
Continue for reps or time.

0979.name: band horizontal pallof press
0979.description: A Pallof press with a band anchored to the side, pressing out and holding. It trains the core to resist rotation.
instructions: Attach the band to a sturdy anchor point at waist height.
Stand perpendicular to the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the band handle with both hands and step away from the anchor point to create tension in the band.
Bring your hands to your chest, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.
Engage your core and maintain a stable stance.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you, pushing the band away from your body.
Hold the extended position for a few seconds, focusing on maintaining tension in your core.
Slowly bring your hands back to your chest, resisting the pull of the band.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

6211.name: bicycle crunch
6211.description: A pedalling crunch where you bring each elbow toward the opposite knee. It works the abs and obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands by your head.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees up.
Twist to bring one elbow to the opposite knee.
Extend the other leg.
Switch sides in a pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

4170.name: bear plank
4170.description: A plank on hands and toes with knees hovering just off the floor. It challenges the core and shoulders.
instructions: Start on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders.
Tuck your toes and lift your knees a few centimetres off the floor.
Keep your back flat and hips level.
Brace your abs and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower your knees to rest.

0133.name: bent knee side plank
0133.description: A side plank with the knees bent, a more approachable version of the full move. It strengthens the obliques and the side of the hip.
instructions: Lie on your side with your knees bent and your elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your hips and knees.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from knee to head.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower your hips with control.
Repeat on the other side.

0867.name: reverse plank
0867.description: A plank held face up, supported on your hands and heels. It strengthens the back of the body and opens up the chest.
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs straight and hands behind your hips, fingers pointing forward.
Press into your hands and heels to lift your hips.
Straighten your body from head to heels.
Squeeze your glutes and keep your shoulders away from your ears.
Hold for 20-45 seconds.
Lower your hips with control.

1326.name: chin-up
1326.description: Hang from a bar with an underhand grip and pull until your chin clears it. A classic builder of the lats and biceps.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your palms facing towards you and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull your body up towards the bar, leading with your chest.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

0253.name: chin-ups (narrow parallel grip)
0253.description: A chin-up on a bar with a narrow parallel grip and the palms facing in. It works the lats, upper back and biceps.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a narrow parallel grip, palms facing towards you.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

4718.name: band assisted chin up
4718.description: A chin-up with a band under your feet or knees to reduce the load. It helps you build toward unassisted reps.
instructions: Hang from a bar with an underhand grip and the band looped under your feet.
Engage your lats and keep your core tight.
Pull your chin over the bar.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight and repeat.
